findings.claim: The PR throws a NoRelayerDefinedError when no relayer is defined, which contradicts the Stage 1 (kill switch) behavior where no relayer configured should fall back to the current production flow of no fee collection and non-mandatory Gelato relay, rather than erroring.
Leftover references to the environment variables RELAY_DAILY_LIMIT_CHAIN_IDS, RELAY_FEE_CHAIN_IDS, and RELAY_SIMULATION_CHAIN_IDS remain in this file even though they should have been removed.
Leftover references to the environment variables RELAY_DAILY_LIMIT_CHAIN_IDS, RELAY_FEE_CHAIN_IDS, and RELAY_SIMULATION_CHAIN_IDS remain in this file even though they should have been removed.
The logic here may be incomplete because it should simply retrieve the configured relayer, but this approach may not hold for Phase 3, where a new specific GTF relayer will exist.

The error message "Pay with Safe not available for this chain." is inaccurate since Pay with Safe will actually be available in Phase 3; a clearer message would state that no relayer using the Fee Service is configured for this chain.
